---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a task-progress improvement

## Problem

What is difficult to understand or accomplish today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the interaction and the evidence the progress display should use. Note whether it affects the main turn, teammates, commands, or AI observations.

## Tradeoffs

Would this require extra model requests, increase resource use, or display an estimate with limited evidence?

## Alternatives

Include examples using synthetic task names and data. Do not include private prompts, project transcripts, credentials, or personal paths.
